articles.title_en: The Life Cycle of Products: Evidence and Implications
articles.title_cn: 产品的生命周期：证据与启示
articles.abstract_en: We document that sales of individual products decline steadily throughout most of the product life cycle. Products quickly become obsolete as they face competition from newer products sold by competing firms and the same firm. We build a dynamic model that highlights an innovation-obsolescence cycle, where firms need to introduce new products to grow; otherwise, their portfolios become obsolete as rivals introduce their own new products. By introducing new products, however, firms accelerate the decline of their own existing products, further depressing their sales. This mechanism has sizable implications for quantifying economic growth and the impact of innovation policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了单个产品的销售额在产品生命周期的大部分时间内持续下降。产品在面临来自竞争企业和同一企业销售的新产品的竞争时，会迅速过时。我们构建了一个动态模型，强调创新-过时循环，其中企业需要推出新产品以增长；否则，随着竞争对手推出自己的新产品，其产品组合将变得过时。然而，通过推出新产品，企业加速了自身现有产品的衰退，进一步抑制了其销售额。这一机制对于量化经济增长和创新政策的影响具有显著意义。

articles.title_en: The Global Distribution of College Graduate Quality
articles.title_cn: 大学毕业生质量的全球分布
articles.abstract_en: We measure college graduate quality—the average human capital of a college’s graduates—for graduates from 2,800 colleges in 48 countries. Graduates of colleges in the richest countries have 50% more human capital than graduates of colleges in the poorest countries. Migration reinforces these differences: emigrants from poorer countries are highly positively selected on human capital. Finally, we show that these stocks and flows matter for growth and development by showing that college graduate quality predicts the share of a college’s students who become inventors, engage in entrepreneurship, and become top executives both within and across countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量了来自2,800个国家48所大学的毕业生质量——即一所大学毕业生平均人力资本。最富裕国家大学的毕业生比最贫穷国家大学的毕业生拥有50%更多人力资本。移民加剧了这些差异：来自较贫穷国家的移民在人力资本方面具有高度正向选择性。最后，我们通过展示大学毕业生质量预测了大学学生中成为发明家、从事创业活动以及成为高层管理人员的比例，无论是在国内还是跨国层面，这些存量和流量对增长和发展都很重要。

articles.title_en: Piercing through Opacity: Relationships and Credit Card Lending to Consumers and Small Businesses during Normal Times and the COVID-19 Crisis
articles.title_cn: 穿透透明度：正常时期与COVID-19危机期间关系与信用卡对消费者和小企业的贷款
articles.abstract_en: We build a bridge between relationship lending and transactions lending—investigating relationship effects on contract terms for credit cards, a relatively pure transactions-lending technology. Using more than 1 million accounts, we find that during normal times, consumers with relationships obtain better terms but small businesses with relationships do not. Both groups obtain improved terms during COVID-19, consistent with intertemporal smoothing—relationship borrowers obtain more favorable terms during crises, paid for by worse terms in normal times. Among other findings, CARES Act impediments to reporting consumer delinquencies to credit bureaus, designed to protect customers, reduced informational value of credit scores, penalizing safer consumers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在关系贷款和交易贷款之间架起一座桥梁——研究关系对信用卡合同条款的影响，信用卡是一种相对纯粹的交易贷款技术。使用超过1百万个账户，我们发现，在正常时期，有关系消费者获得更好的条款，但有小企业关系的则不然。两组在COVID-19期间均获得改善的条款，这与跨期平滑一致——关系借款人在危机期间获得更有利的条款，以正常时期较差的条款为代价。在其他发现中，旨在保护客户的CARES法案对向信用局报告消费者违约的阻碍，降低了信用评分的信息价值，惩罚了更安全的消费者。

articles.title_en: The Human Capital–Reproductive Capital Trade-Off in Marriage Market Matching
articles.title_cn: 婚姻市场匹配中的人力资本与生育资本权衡
articles.abstract_en: Throughout the twentieth century, the relationship between women’s human capital and men’s income was nonmonotonic: while college-educated women married richer spouses than high school–educated women, graduate-educated women married poorer spouses than college-educated women. This can be rationalized by a bidimensional matching framework where women’s human capital is negatively correlated with another valuable trait: fertility, or reproductive capital. Such a model predicts nonmonotonicity in income matching with a sufficiently high income distribution of men. A simulation of the model using US Census fertility and income data shows that it can also predict the recent transition to more assortative matching as desired family sizes have fallen.
articles.abstract_cn: 在整个二十世纪，女性人力资本与男性收入之间的关系是非单调的：虽然受过大学教育的女性比只受过高中教育的女性嫁给了更富有的配偶，但受过研究生教育的女性却比受过大学教育的女性嫁给了更贫穷的配偶。这可以通过一个二维匹配框架来解释，其中女性的人力资本与另一个有价值的特征——生育能力，即生育资本——呈负相关。这样的模型预测，在男性收入分布足够高的情况下，收入匹配会出现非单调性。使用美国人口普查的生育率和收入数据对该模型进行的模拟表明，随着理想家庭规模的下降，该模型也能预测近期向更强烈的选型匹配的转变。

articles.abstract_en: We show how real and financial frictions amplify, prolong, and propagate the negative impact of uncertainty shocks. We use a novel instrumentation strategy to address endogeneity in estimating the impact of uncertainty by exploiting differential firm exposure to exchange rate, policy, and energy price volatility. We show that financially constrained firms cut investment more than unconstrained firms following an uncertainty shock. We then build a general equilibrium heterogeneous firms model with real and financial frictions, finding that financial frictions (i) amplify uncertainty shocks by doubling their impact on output; (ii) increase persistence by doubling the duration of the drop; and (iii) propagate uncertainty shocks by spreading their impact onto financial variables.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了实际摩擦和金融摩擦如何放大、延长并传播不确定性冲击的负面影响。我们采用一种新颖的工具变量策略来解决估计不确定性影响时的内生性问题，利用企业对外汇、政策和能源价格波动的差异化敞口。我们表明，在不确定性冲击之后，受融资约束的企业比不受约束的企业更大幅度地削减投资。然后，我们构建了一个包含实际摩擦和金融摩擦的异质性企业一般均衡模型，发现金融摩擦（i）通过使不确定性冲击对产出的影响翻倍来放大冲击；（ii）通过使下降持续时间翻倍来增加持续性；以及（iii）通过将冲击的影响扩散到金融变量来传播不确定性冲击。

articles.title_en: Beyond the Balance Sheet Model of Banking: Implications for Bank Regulation and Monetary Policy
articles.title_cn: 超越银行资产负债表模型：对银行监管与货币政策的影响
articles.abstract_en: We empirically document two adjustment margins that are usually absent from the predominant “bank balance sheet lending” view of financial intermediation. For the shadow bank substitution margin, shadow banks substitute for traditional banks among loans that are easily sold. For the balance sheet retention margin, banks switch between balance sheet lending and selling loans based on their balance sheet strength. Estimates from a structural model show that these margins significantly shape policy responses, dampening the effect of capital requirements on lending whose costs are borne by wealthier borrowers. Secondary-market disruptions such as quantitative easing have significantly larger impacts on lending than capital requirements.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们实证记录了两种通常在主流的“银行资产负债表贷款”金融中介观点中缺失的调整边际。对于影子银行替代边际，影子银行在易于出售的贷款中替代传统银行。对于资产负债表留存边际，银行根据其资产负债表实力在资产负债表贷款和出售贷款之间切换。结构模型的估计表明，这些边际显著影响政策反应，削弱了资本要求对贷款的影响，其成本由较富裕的借款人承担。诸如量化宽松等二级市场干扰对贷款的影响显著大于资本要求。

articles.title_en: When It Rains It Pours: Cascading Uncertainty Shocks
articles.title_cn: 屋漏偏逢连夜雨：级联不确定性冲击
articles.abstract_en: The effects of uncertainty shocks are superadditive. On the basis of local projections, we find that the combination of nearby positive shocks can be multiple times more powerful than the sum of their stand-alone effects. In a standard New Keynesian dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model, uncertainty shocks are proven to be superadditive only when the model is solved under fourth- (or higher-)order perturbation. The fourth-order solution unlocks the fourth derivative of marginal utility, “edginess,” which is key to generating stronger reactions to multiple risks and superadditivity. Intuitively, an agent already bearing one risk is less willing to bear another in the presence of edginess.
articles.abstract_cn: 不确定性冲击的影响具有超加性。基于局部投影法，我们发现邻近正向冲击的组合效应可能数倍于其单独效应之和。在标准新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡模型中，只有当模型采用四阶（或更高阶）扰动求解时，不确定性冲击才被证明具有超加性。四阶解开启了边际效用的四阶导数，即“边际敏感度”，这是产生对多重风险更强反应及超加性的关键。直观上，在存在边际敏感度的情况下，已经承担一种风险的代理人更不愿意承担另一种风险。
